arxiv-1907-03454.title: Privacy-Preserving Speaker Recognition with Cohort Score Normalisation
arxiv-1907-03454.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by . In many voice biometrics applications there is a requirement to preserve privacy, not least because of the recently enforced General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Though progress in bringing privacy preservation to voice biometrics is lagging behind developments in other biometrics communities, recent years have seen rapid progress, with secure computation mechanisms such as homomorphic encryption being applied successfully to speaker recognition. Even so, the computational overhead incurred by processing speech data in the encrypted domain is substantial.

arxiv-2103-07950.description: Abstract The increasing usage of machine learning (ML) coupled with the software architectural challenges of the modern era has resulted in two broad research areas: i) software architecture for ML-based systems, which focuses on developing architectural techniques for better developing ML-based software systems, and ii) ML for software architectures, which focuses on developing ML techniques to better architect traditional software

arxiv-2210-15781.title: A Compact End-to-End Model with Local and Global Context for Spoken Language Identification
arxiv-2210-15781.creator: Fei Jia, Nithin Rao Koluguri, Jagadeesh Balam, Boris Ginsburg
arxiv-2210-15781.description: Abstract We introduce TitaNet-LID , a compact end-to-end neural network for Spoken Language Identification (LID) that is based on the ContextNet architecture. TitaNet-LID employs 1D depth-wise separable convolutions and Squeeze-and-Excitation layers to effectively capture local and global context within an utterance.

arxiv-2402-13850.title: Conformal and Non-Minimal Couplings in Fractional Cosmology
arxiv-2402-13850.creator: Kevin Marroquín ID, Genly Leon ID, Alfredo D. Millano ID, Claudio Michea ID, Andronikos Paliathanasis ID
arxiv-2402-13850.description: Abstract Fractional differential calculus is a mathematical tool that has found applications in the study of social and physical behaviors considered “anomalous”. It is often used when traditional integer derivatives models fail to represent cases where the power law is observed accurately. Fractional calculus must reflect non-local, frequency- and history-dependent properties of power-law phenomena.

arxiv-2505-00113.title: Doubly robust augmented weighting estimators for the analysis of externally controlled single-arm trials and unanchored indirect treatment comparisons
arxiv-2505-00113.creator: Harlan Campbell, Antonio Remiro-Azócar
arxiv-2505-00113.description: Abstract Externally controlled single-arm trials are critical to assess treatment efficacy across therapeutic indications for which randomized controlled trials are not feasible. A closely-related research design, the unanchored indirect treatment comparison, is often required for disconnected treatment networks in health technology assessment. We present a unified causal inference framework for both research designs.

arxiv-2507-22933.title: Augmented Vision-Language Models: A Systematic Review
arxiv-2507-22933.creator: Anthony C Davis tony.davis@jhuapl.edu, Burhan Sadiq bsadiq1@jhu.edu, Tianmin Shu tianmin.shu@jhu.edu, Chien-Ming Huang chienming.huang@jhu.edu
arxiv-2507-22933.description: Abstract Recent advances in visual-language machine learning models have demonstrated exceptional ability to use natural language and understand visual scenes by training on large, unstructured datasets. However, this training paradigm cannot produce interpretable explanations for its outputs, requires retraining to integrate new information, is highly resource-intensive, and struggles with certain forms of logical reasoning.

pmc-10588680.title: Immune Cell Abundance and T-cell Receptor Landscapes Suggest New Patient Stratification Strategies in Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
pmc-10588680.creator: Maria Secrier, Lara McGrath, Felicia Ng, Sakshi Gulati, Amelia Raymond, Barrett R. B. Nuttall, Julie Berthe, Emma V. Jones, Ben S. Sidders, Jérôme Galon, J. Carl Barrett, Helen K. Angell
pmc-10588680.description: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma (HNSCC) is a molecularly and spatially heterogeneous disease frequently characterized by impairment of immunosurveillance mechanisms. Despite recent success with immunotherapy treatment, disease progression still occurs quickly after treatment in the majority of cases, suggesting the need to improve patient selection strategies.

pmc-11518420.title: Youth mental health and exposome
pmc-11518420.creator: J Lindert, E Olariu, I Lopes
pmc-11518420.description: Mental health is a complex Public Health challenge, especially youth. A better understanding of factors that contribute to youth mental health and reduce the burden of youth mental health conditions such as executive and emotional functioning is needed to develop primary and secondary prevention interventions.

pmc-11665775.title: Virtual reality‐based preoperative planning for optimized trocar placement in thoracic surgery: A preliminary study
pmc-11665775.creator: Arash Harirpoush, George Rakovich, Marta Kersten‐Oertel, Yiming Xiao
pmc-11665775.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Video‐assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) is a minimally invasive approach for treating early‐stage non‐small‐cell lung cancer. Optimal trocar placement during VATS ensures comprehensive access to the thoracic cavity, provides a panoramic endoscopic view, and prevents instrument crowding. While established principles such as the Baseball Diamond Principle (BDP) and Triangle Target Principle (TTP) exist, surgeons mainly rely on experience and patient‐specific anatomy for trocar placement, potentially leading to sub‐optimal surgical plans that increase operative time and fatigue.

pmc-12400656.title: Prevalence and clinical correlates of focal choroidal excavation in a large cohort of Chinese patients with choroidal osteoma
pmc-12400656.creator: Yi Xuan, Wenyi Tang, Xiaofeng Ye, Wei Liu, Gezhi Xu, Min Wang, Qing Chang
pmc-12400656.description: PurposeTo describe the prevalence and clinical characteristics of focal choroidal excavation (FCE) in a large cohort of Chinese patients with choroidal osteoma (CO).MethodsOne hundred and thirty-two eyes of 110 Chinese patients diagnosed with CO were enrolled. The prevalence and clinical characteristics of FCE were studied.

pmc-12471317.title: High Power Density X-Band GaN-on-Si HEMTs with 10.2 W/mm Used by Low Parasitic Gold-Free Ohmic Contact
pmc-12471317.creator: Jiale Du, Hao Lu, Bin Hou, Ling Yang, Meng Zhang, Mei Wu, Kaiwen Chen, Tianqi Pan, Yifan Chen, Hailin Liu, Qingyuan Chang, Xiaohua Ma, Yue Hao
pmc-12471317.description: To enhance the RF power properties of CMOS-compatible gold-free GaN devices, this work introduces a kind of GaN-on-Si HEMT with a low parasitic regrown ohmic contact technology. Attributed to the highly doped n+ InGaN regrown layer and smooth morphology of gold-free ohmic stacks, the lowest ohmic contact resistance (Rc) was presented as 0.072 Ω·mm.

pmc-12488344.title: Incidence, Risk Factors, and Mortality Associated with Tuberculosis in Solid Organ Transplant Recipients in Taiwan
pmc-12488344.creator: Shao-Yuan Chuang, Ching-Fang Tang, Kuan-Hung Lin, Chia-Hung Lai, Yu-Tsung Yin, Min-Kuang Tsai, Mai-Szu Wu, Mei-Yi Wu
pmc-12488344.description: Background Solid organ transplantation (SOT) recipients are at increased risk of post-transplant tuberculosis (TB). However, the effect of this risk on mortality remains unclear. We examined the incidence and risk factors of posttransplant TB, and its effect on mortality in SOT recipients in Taiwan.

pmc-12579879.title: Bilateral Cerebellar Hemispheric Ischemia in Cryptococcal Meningitis
pmc-12579879.creator: Abdul Safi, John L Liu, Mittal Prajapati, Ram Narayan
pmc-12579879.description: Bilateral cerebellar hemispheric ischemia is a rare complication of cryptococcal meningitis that may lead to significant neurologic morbidity. We present the case of a 70-year-old male with asplenia who developed progressive headaches, confusion, and fever. Neurological exam and brain MRI were unremarkable. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) showed lymphocytic pleocytosis with elevated protein and low glucose levels.

pmc-12610758.title: Mitochondrial Function, Oxidative Stress, Inflammation and Thrombolytic Treatment in Ischemic Stroke
pmc-12610758.creator: Eleonora Kovacheva, Maria Gevezova, Margarita Koeva, Valentina Mihaylova, Vasilka Kormova, Emanuela Kostadinova, Yulia Kostadinova, Maria Kazakova, Victoria Sarafian, Josephine S Modica-Napolitano
pmc-12610758.description: Ischemic stroke (IS) is a leading cause of mortality worldwide, responsible for approximately 55% of all neurological disabilities. Proper brain function requires continuous energy supply, primarily generated by mitochondria. Cerebral ischemia impairs the functioning of mitochondrial electron transport chain, reducing adenosine triphosphate production and increasing reactive oxygen species. Inflammation also plays a critical role throughout all stroke phases.

pmc-12692194.description: The recycling of by-products from fish processing procedures has recently been attracting increased attention. In this study, three types of gelatin were isolated from grass carp skin, bone, and scales, named SKG, BG, and SCG, respectively, and their structural and functional characteristics were investigated. Compared with BG and SCG, SKG exhibited the highest extraction yield (18.30 ± 0.

pmc-12728211.title: Catalytic asymmetric tandem Heck/Sonogashira reaction enabling access to versatile chiral bridged ring scaffolds
pmc-12728211.creator: Jing Zhong, Mengxian Li, Changhui Wu, Hui Li, Hongyue Dong, Chunchen Che, Aijun Lin, Hequan Yao
pmc-12728211.description: Bridged-ring scaffolds are prevalent in numerous natural products and pharmaceuticals. However, achieving enantioselective construction of these architectures presents a significant challenge, due to the considerable structural strain of the products and the presence of multiple stereocenters. Herein, we report a Pd/Cu co-catalyzed substrate-dependent enantiodivergent tandem Heck/Sonogashira reaction for the synthesis of alkyne-tethered (R,S,S)-bicyclo[3.2.1]octenes and (S,R,R)-benzo-bicyclo[3.2.

pmc-13035693.title: Complications and outcomes after definitive surgery for traumatic high-energy pelvic fractures
pmc-13035693.creator: Kaarina Birgitta Salonpää, Juho Nurkkala, Ulla Koskela, Iikka Lantto, Sanna Kakko, Timo Kaakinen, Janne Liisanantti
pmc-13035693.description: BackgroundPostoperative complications and prolonged recovery are often recorded in traumatic high-energy pelvic fractures. This study aimed to assess the rate of postoperative complications and identify factors associated with their occurrence following surgical treatment.MethodsThis retrospective study included 162 patients with traumatic high-energy pelvic fractures who underwent surgery at Oulu University Hospital between 2010 and 2021.

pmc-13214805.title: Circular RNAs in Intestinal Mucosal Homeostasis and Pathologies
pmc-13214805.creator: Hee Kyoung Chung, Lan Xiao, Jian-Ying Wang
pmc-13214805.description: The mammalian intestinal epithelium is a rapid self-renewal tissue in the body, serving as a critical interface between the host and the external environment. Maintaining the intestinal epithelium homeostasis requires precise coordination of cellular processes, including proliferation, migration, differentiation, autophagy, and cell-to-cell interaction.

pmc-13330655.title: Potential of Stevia rebaudiana Bertoni Aquatic Extract in Treating Diabetes-Induced Infertility: Effects on Autophagy and Apoptosis
pmc-13330655.creator: Mozhdeh Zamani, Farhad Koohpeyma, Alireza Raeisi, Pooneh Mokarram, Sanaz Dastghaib
pmc-13330655.description: Backgrounds:Infertility is one of the major complications of diabetes. Diabetic-mediated oxidative stress could destroy autophagy in testes, leading to damaged sperm and male infertility. Stevia rebaudiana Bertoni is a medicinal herb with various health-beneficial effects, such as improving diabetes-induced infertility. However, till now, no exact mechanism is known for its effects on diabetic testes.

pmc-13394680.title: Sex Representation in US Stroke Clinical Trials: A Decade of Trends and Challenges
pmc-13394680.creator: Chaitali Dagli, Mudasir Andrabi, Tova Cohen, Pranali G Patel, Tapasya Katta, Chen Lin
pmc-13394680.description: ObjectiveStroke remains a major cause of disability and mortality in the US, with significant sex‐based disparities, and females remain underrepresented in stroke clinical trials. We aimed to examine sex representation in US‐based stroke clinical trials, identify trial characteristics associated with higher female enrollment (≥ 50%), and explore factors influencing recruitment strategies.

pmc-13463474.title: Effects of Early Fructooligosaccharides Intervention on Growth Performance and Jejunal Development in Suckling Piglets
pmc-13463474.creator: Zhuang Hao, Xuedong Ding, Yajun Gao, Zexu Li, Jing Wang
pmc-13463474.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryThe suckling period is a critical stage for intestinal development in young mammals, during which the gastrointestinal tract remains highly adaptive to environmental factors and is strongly influenced by nutrient intake and microbial communities. In this study, we used suckling piglets as an animal model and fructooligosaccharides (FOSs) as an early nutritional intervention to explore the effect and mechanism of FOSs on the development of the small intestine.

pmc-13473219.title: A bibliometric analysis of research on developmental dysplasia of the hip (2000–2025): Trends, leading contributors, impact, and collaboration patterns
pmc-13473219.creator: Murat Koçak, Feza Korkusuz, Mehmet İsmail Safa Kapıcıoğlu, Hakan Ömeroğlu
pmc-13473219.description: PurposeIt was aimed to evaluate publication trends, scientific impact, and collaboration patterns in developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) research.MethodsDDH-related publications indexed in the Web of Science database between January 1, 2000, and December 31, 2025, were analyzed. Publication output, citation metrics, author and institutional collaboration networks, leading journals, and major research themes were assessed.

pmc-13478333.title: Impact of air-ice CO2 fluxes on polar ocean carbon budgets from a bipolar data compilation
pmc-13478333.creator: Odile Crabeck, Daiki Nomura, Laique M Djeutchouang, Victoria R Dutch, Sebastien Moreau, G T Else Brent, Lisa A Miller, Bruno Delille
pmc-13478333.description: In ocean carbon budget assessments, sea ice is still treated as an impermeable barrier, rather than a dynamic interface mediating CO₂ exchange between ocean and atmosphere. We compiled more than 6000 chamber-based air–ice CO₂ flux measurements from the Arctic and Southern Oceans between 2003 and 2021, spanning diverse ice, snow, and seasonal conditions.
